analysis.insight_summary: Users face challenges updating [product_name] [document] from older CD-based [version_no] to newer releases, especially due to lack of compatible hardware and OS requirements (e.g., no CD drives and needing Windows 10 compatibility). The main takeaway is that users find it complex to obtain valid installation media and navigate upgrade steps as technology evolves. Clearer instructions for upgrades, downloads, and compatibility are essential.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward way to install and upgrade to the current [product_name] [document] version, without relying on a CD drive or experiencing compatibility problems with Windows 10.
